A power that gives you sight like a bird in the sky.
For \c[60]100 turns\c[0], you can see the positions
of enemies and allies outside the screen.

持续\c[60]100回合\c[0]，可看到
画面外的敌人与同伴的位置。
无需\c[61]集中\c[0]即可施放。

entries.source:
Strengthen your defense with your unshakeable
willpower. \c[61]ST\c[0] reduces by \c[62]1\c[0] each turn, but \c[61]Phys
Dmg\c[0] is reduced by \c[60]1/3\c[0], and \c[61]HP\c[0] regenerates
every turn. The effect is canceled if you move.
